### main.LAST_HASH.hot-update.js

#### Changed Modules


#### Changed Runtime Modules
- webpack/runtime/chunk_group_map
- webpack/runtime/get_full_hash

#### Changed Content
```js
"use strict";
self["rspackHotUpdate"]("main", {},function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();
// webpack/runtime/chunk_group_map
(() => {
((groups) => {
	var map = __webpack_require__.hmrS_chunkGroups = __webpack_require__.hmrS_chunkGroups || Object.create(null);
	
	Object.keys(groups).forEach((chunkId) => {
		if (groups[chunkId] === null) delete map[chunkId];
		else map[chunkId] = groups[chunkId];
	});
})({"late":["shared"],"page":["shared"]});


})();

}
);
```
